name: moodle-quiz-extractor
description: Extensión de navegador (Firefox y Chrome) para exportar cuestionarios de Moodle a Markdown, JSON e imágenes, con autollenado seguro.

scripts.smoke:chrome: WXT_SMOKE=1 wxt build -b chrome && node tests/smoke/chrome.mjs
scripts.smoke:firefox: WXT_SMOKE=1 wxt build -b firefox --mv3 && node tests/smoke/firefox.mjs
